## What landed

- `exports/src/exports/entity_page.py` — the `sig.entity-page/1` contract (K2 §6.2):
  `page_state` renders the A-10 decision (`published` / `not_yet_reviewed` / `withheld` /
  `unpaged`); `build_twin` emits the record — claims grouped by predicate with the four
  epistemic fields separate (SIG-UI-004), H-2 relationship rows in both directions
  (entity-ref claims + materialized access edges joined on claim id) with historical and
  undated marked, `access.degree_only` as node attributes never edges (SIG-UI-117),
  SIG-UI-080's withheld notice verbatim when a counterparty drops, and contract-B
  sections (`contradictions`, `timeline`, `related`, `downloads`) as typed empty values.
- `exports/src/exports/spine_export.py` — the `entity_page_claims` read (publishable
  claims on page-kind subjects AND objects, rights-joined for compartment filing) and
  the per-compartment emission at `web/entity/<url_type>/<slug>--<hash>/index.<comp>.json`,
  schema-registered so the release descriptor lists it (SIG-EXPORT-014).
- `web/src/lib/entity-page.ts` — the TypeScript mirror: twin/review-record types,
  `pageState`, `entityIndex` (SIG-UI-070 counts + ER disclosure), committed fixtures
  (auto-allowed agency twin + the `not_yet_reviewed` organisation pair).
- `web/src/lib/data.ts` — `getEntityLabelRows()` + `getEntityPageTwins(urlType, key)`
  (export mode scans `labels/*.jsonl` + `web/entity/<type>/<key>/index.*.json`).
